name: ID
description: Tiny RCU identity, ASCII TRCU.

name: VERSION
description: RCU register ABI version 1.0.

name: CAPABILITY
description: Selected clock backend and lifecycle capabilities; IHP130 compatibility reads 0x00001A03.
fields: Physical PLL macro selected; this is not a lock or timing qualification flag.

name: CLOCK_REQUEST
description: Requested profile; CLOCK_APPLY performs the bounded drain/switch sequence.
fields: 0 SAFE24; 1 direct XIN on no-PLL compatibility; 2 PLL192; 3 PLL240 on ICS55.

name: CLOCK_CURRENT
description: Committed profile. Read rate snapshots after completion, including fallback.
fields: 0 SAFE24; 1 direct XIN on no-PLL compatibility; 2 PLL192; 3 PLL240 on ICS55.

name: COMMAND
description: Write exactly one operation bit: 1 clock, 2 gate, 4 local reset, or 8 system reset. Reads zero.

name: STATUS
description: Live operation, source and fault observations; after cold reset SAFE_SOURCE is set. PLL status is external.
fields: Accepted command bitmask, zero after completion.

name: TIMEOUT
description: Transition budget in REF24 cycles; zero is rejected.
fields: Hardware transition/drain budget, not a software polling-iteration count.

name: GATE_REQUEST
description: Desired stopped-target mask; apply with GATE_APPLY after clients release ownership.
fields: Target bits selected by TARGET_CAP. Bit 15 (PIO-lite) is absent; bit 16 is SPI0 and bit 17 is PPALite. Unimplemented bits must be zero.

name: GATE_STATUS
description: Actual target gates observed by the backend; read after command completion.
fields: Target bits selected by TARGET_CAP. Bit 15 (PIO-lite) is absent; bit 16 is SPI0 and bit 17 is PPALite. Unimplemented bits must be zero.

name: RESET_REQUEST
description: Selected local-reset targets. CPU bit 0 and unsupported target bits are rejected.
fields: Target bits selected by TARGET_CAP. Bit 15 (PIO-lite) is absent; bit 16 is SPI0 and bit 17 is PPALite. Unimplemented bits must be zero.

name: RESET_DONE
description: Completed local resets for the last accepted operation; not inferred from a write to COMMAND.
fields: Target bits selected by TARGET_CAP. Bit 15 (PIO-lite) is absent; bit 16 is SPI0 and bit 17 is PPALite. Unimplemented bits must be zero.

name: RESET_CAUSE
description: Sticky reset causes; hardware set wins over clear. Warm system reset retains this record.

name: FAULT
description: Sticky lifecycle faults; clearing does not repair a clock, drain traffic or release resource ownership.
fields: Bit 0 invalid/busy configuration; remaining bits report backend drain/source/lifecycle failure. Preserve the full mask during recovery.

name: IRQ_STATE
description: Sticky completion and fault causes. A new hardware event wins over acknowledgement.

name: IRQ_ENABLE
description: Enable completion/fault delivery on core input bit 31.

name: XIN_HZ
description: Configured external reference input rate. Units are Hz; SYS/MEM/PCLK change after a completed RCU transition.

name: REF_HZ
description: Normalized always-on reference rate. Units are Hz; SYS/MEM/PCLK change after a completed RCU transition.

name: SYS_HZ
description: Committed CPU, SRAM and fabric clock rate. Units are Hz; SYS/MEM/PCLK change after a completed RCU transition.
fields: Committed CPU, SRAM and fabric clock rate.

name: MEM_HZ
description: Committed XPI clock rate. Units are Hz; SYS/MEM/PCLK change after a completed RCU transition.

name: PCLK_HZ
description: Committed peripheral clock rate. Units are Hz; SYS/MEM/PCLK change after a completed RCU transition.

name: CLINT_HZ
description: CLINT timebase rate; independent of the selected SYS profile. Units are Hz; SYS/MEM/PCLK change after a completed RCU transition.
fields: CLINT timebase rate; independent of the selected SYS profile.

name: TARGET_CAP
description: Implemented target bitmap: bits 0..14, SPI0 bit 16 and PPALite bit 17. PIO-lite bit 15 is absent.
fields: Target bits selected by TARGET_CAP. Bit 15 (PIO-lite) is absent; bit 16 is SPI0 and bit 17 is PPALite. Unimplemented bits must be zero.

name: CLKOUT
description: Disable and wait for idle before changing source/divider. Output frequency is source/(2*half_period), at most the implemented 24 MHz digital ceiling.
fields: Nonzero integer half period when enabled; reset leaves CLKOUT off.
